newsitem.title: USA: Conseco Inc Q3 oper net rises.
newsitem.headline: Conseco Inc Q3 oper net rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: Q3 oper results exclude trading income (losses), realized investment gains (losses), restructuring income (losses) and an extraordinary charge. Q3 net was $78.1 million or $0.99/shr diluted vs $43.5 million or $0.84/shr diluted.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: All share, per-share data adjusted for two-for-one stock split distributed April 1, 1996.
Nine-month operating results exclude trading losses of $4.2 million or $0.06/shr vs losses of $500,000 or $0.01/shr.
Results also exclude realized losses of $2.2 million or $0.03/shr vs gains of $4.1 million or $0.08/shr and restructuring income of $17.7 million or $0.26/shr vs $74.9 million or $1.44/shr.
1996 nine-month results exclude extraordinary charge of $18.6 million or $0.28/shr for early retirement of debt.
Nine-month net was $174.5 million or $2.59/shr diluted vs $167.8 million or $3.22/shr diluted.
